newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Avalanches kill five in Swiss Alps.
newsitem.headline: Avalanches kill five in Swiss Alps.

text.p: Avalanches killed five people in the Swiss Alps at the weekend, bringing to 16 the number of deaths since late last year, police said on Monday.

Avalanches, which often strike in remote areas away from the developed ski hills, killed two Swiss skiers in Montana region and a German climber near central Brisen region, the Swiss news agency ATS said.

Near the popular ski resort of Klosters, a 26-year-old snowboarder died of his injuries after being hit by a snow slide and rescuers found the body of another man in Heremence region on Sunday, police said.
At least 10 people have been killed by avalanches in Switzerland so far this month.
